column2: Umbhalo nezinxibelelwano zezwi/ividiyo eziyi-1:1 — ngaphandle kwenombolo yefowuni, izitshixo nemibhalo kwisixhobo sakho.
I-Ghal Bol: ngexesha lokwenyani, ngasese, imiyalezo nezinxibelelwano ukusuka kwisixhobo ukuya kwesinye

Imveliso ephuma phantsi kophawu lwe-Ghal Bol — umbhalo ofihliweyo usuka kwisixhobo uya kwesinye, iziqinisekiso zokuhanjiswa nokufundwa, nezinxibelelwano zemveli zezwi nevidiyo phakathi kwabo bakwi-intanethi. Igama loluntu le-app ngu-Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Imiyalezo itywinwa kwisixhobo sakho. Ibhokisi yokuhanjiswa igcina umbhalo ofihliweyo ongaqondakaliyo de umamkeli aqinisekise.
Izinxibelelwano zidibanisa ukusuka kwisixhobo ziya kwesinye ku-LAN xa kunokwenzeka, kungenjalo ngebhulorho elula yokulungelelanisa engazange ikhuphe imfihlo kwimidiya.
Ufakelo ngalunye lwenza ubuni bendawo bokufihla. Mema nge-QR okanye ikhonkco — ngaphandle kwenombolo yefowuni nangaphandle kokungena koluntu.
Indwendwe iskena i-QR yomgcini (okanye ivula ikhonkco lesimemo). Indwendwe igcina isitshixo soluntu somgcini ize itsalele. I-QR kuwo omabini amacala ayifuneki.
Yabelana ngekhonkco lakho elithi https://ghalbol.com/connect/… okanye i-QR evela ku-Mema ku-Ghal Bol.
Bayivula ku-Ghal Bol (okanye bayifaka kuqala ku-Play / Linux).
Xa bobabini befinyeleleka, incoko nezinxibelelwano ziyadibanisa — ezinxibelelwaneni iindlela ze-LAN ne-WAN zihamba kunye.
Iipakethe ze-Windows zakhiwa kwindawo yomsebenzi enye. Ukhuphelo loluntu kwesi sayithi yipakethe yedesika ye-Linux; i-Android iphuma ku-Google Play njenge-com.ghalbol.
Faka i-Ghal Bol ku-Play. Ii-App Links eziqinisekisiweyo zivula izimemo ngqo kwi-app xa kunokwenzeka.
Khupha ingobo yeshishini, emva koko ./install.sh (ngomsebenzisi ngamnye) okanye ./run.sh ukuze uzame apho.

I-Gotigin luphawu lorhwebo (Apho ubugcisa buhlangana nokufumanisa). I-GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED yinkampani. I-Ghal Bol luphawu lweemveliso zonxibelelwano; esi sayithi ngu-ghalbol.com. Isithunywa yile nto iphuma namhlanje. Amagama eepakethe nedomeyini ahlala e-ghalbol — igama elinye. Alukho uphawu olwahlukileyo lwe-camel-case.
Ipakethe yemveliso ye-x86_64. Khupha ingobo uze uqalise i-./install.sh (ngomsebenzisi ngamnye, ku-~/.local) okanye i-./run.sh ukuze uzame apho.
Le bhrawuza eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ayinakuvula i-Ghal Bol. Cofa uluhlu uze uvule eli phepha ku-Chrome, okanye ukope ikhonkco le-app ulifake ku-Ghal Bol → Joyina.
Ngezantsi cofa Vula ku-Ghal Bol. Ukuba akukho nto yenzekayo, kopa ikhonkco le-app ulifake ku-Ghal Bol (Joyina).
Ngena ku-Ghal Bol. Ukhetho olupheleleyo — i-imeyile, i-Google, i-Microsoft, i-GitHub, okanye ifowuni.
Sebenzisa igama lokugqitha elinoonobumba aba-6 ubuncinane.
Iinzame ezininzi kakhulu. Zama kwakhona kamva.
Sebenzisa inombolo yefowuni epheleleyo enekhowudi yelizwe (umz. +91…).
Loo khowudi ye-SMS ayichanekanga okanye iphelelwe lixesha.
I-imeyile ayikaqinisekiswa — jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-imeyile yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — jonga ibhokisi yakho
Akukho nto kule dilesi. Ikhonkco lesimemo libonakala njenge-ghalbol.com/connect/… — jonga ukuba likotshiwe ngokupheleleyo.
